title: CrazyLinks AI operations, schema v1
description: What the AI returns: a summary, a list of operations on the page document, and questions when the request is ambiguous. Flat and non-recursive, additionalProperties false throughout. Custom HTML blocks and custom CSS are not expressible. Block props mirror schemas/page.v1.json (a test keeps them in sync).

summary.description: One or two plain sentences describing the change (or answering an analytics question).

questions.description: Ask instead of guessing. When non-empty, operations should be empty.

weekly.description: Recurring weekly window in the site timezone. days are ISO weekdays (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday); start and end are HH:MM (24-hour). A window belongs to the day it starts on; an end at or before the start runs past midnight into the next day. Both this window and the one-off start/end must be satisfied when both are set.

block_ref.description: An existing block id, or the ref of a block added earlier in this list (new-1, new-2, ...).

profile.description: Page header. Rendered first; there is no separate profile block.

design.description: Design patch. Objects (background, text, button) merge into the current values; setting theme resets background, text, button, accent and radius to the theme first.

url.description: Scheme must be http, https, mailto, tel or sms (enforced by the PHP URL policy).

deep_link.description: Optional app URL scheme. Stored only in Phase 1.

new_until.description: Shows a NEW flag until this time.

thumbnail_alt.description: Alternative text for the thumbnail or featured image. Falls back to the Media Library alt text.

decorative.description: The thumbnail is decorative: renders with empty alt text and silences the missing-alt warning.

op_add_block.description: Adds a block. after_id null puts it first (at the top of the page, or first inside its group); otherwise right after that block, in the same group as that block.

ref.description: Optional name (new-1, new-2, ...) so later operations can refer to this block.

op_update_block.description: Changes a block. props are merged into the current props (only list what changes); the props must belong to the block's type.

op_move_block.description: Moves a block. after_id null moves it first in its parent; parent_id (optional) moves it into a group, or to the top level with null.

op_remove_block.description: Removes a block (a group is removed with its children).

op_set_profile.description: Profile patch, merged into the current profile.
